_doc: Fall 2026 term from the Duke Registrar academic calendar (registrar.duke.edu/2026-2027-academic-calendar/). Break days = no campus dining assumed. plan_start_points = each meal plan's starting balance (Duke Dining Fall 2026 points chart, 'Total Value'). Pace = start balance spread evenly over dining days (start..end minus breaks); our own numbers, not Duke's weekly chart.
